metadataRaw.title: How to Loosen STIFF HIPS in Seconds
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the best exercises to instantly help loosen stiff, achy hips — even within 30 seconds!

These exercises work by stretching and strengthening the main muscles that cause hip stiffness and pain, including the glutes — for both quick and long-lasting relief.

They may also help improve flexibility and mobility in those dealing with hip arthritis, making movement easier and less painful.

Each exercise works differently, targeting different muscles and shown in various positions. To get the best results, go through them all and use what gives you the most relief.

Watch now and quickly loosen stiff hips!
